candidateSelection: Turnover GB and hiring RF are the previously named review candidates. Survey RF is fixed from the original tuning-only table (4.901 versus GB 5.098), not selected using prior or new test performance. No model, hyperparameter, predictor, imputer or training seed changes. Every refit audit, preprocessing statistic and training-prediction hash must equal the frozen parent audit before fresh data generation.
transportConstruction: Weak signal halves the probability-scale effect relative to zero indicator state within the same scenario, preserving drift, reversal intercept and calendar effects. Fast predictors change stationary AR(1) persistence from .94 to .50, retaining variance, streams and three-month causal lag. Delayed predictors add60 days to publication timestamps only. World and scenario labels never enter features. These are new hypothetical stresses, not empirical populations.

gate.definition: Absolute equal-wave OLS slope over latest four complete released waves divided by max(median absolute deviation about the median of seven adjacent differences across latest eight waves),1 score point). Reject only scores strictly above the pooled eligible calibration-case 95th percentile. This detects observable instability, not unseen shocks or causal drift.
gate.scoreUses: Only case.history before target-label extraction. No forecast errors or target labels enter calibration. Match current publication and instrument support guards.
gate.coverage: Retained predictions divided by all baseline-eligible predictions, INCLUDING later-unscorable instrument-break targets; separately report scored coverage and retained/excluded errors. No subgroup-specific threshold fitting.

groups.exposure: Tertiles of released historical_denominator_mean3, calibrated separately per domain using eligible new calibration inputs only; np.quantile linear at1/3,2/3. No future denominators. Minimum20 distinct reference test seeds per exposure group; transport exposure groups descriptive only.
groups.predictorMissing: Any of the three latest released indicators is null.
groups.stale: Latest predictor effective age exceeds60 days.
groups.interpretation: Operational aggregate support groups only. No employee demographic attributes exist, so demographic fairness is not assessed. Rare missing/stale groups below20 reference or10 transport seeds are labeled insufficient coverage, never claimed robust.

acceptance: Adopt-for-synthetic-demo only if EVERY prespecified applicable condition passes against EACH co-primary comparator, retaining original support. Reference aggregate MAE improves at least5%, upper95% paired seed-cluster error-difference interval is below0, no scored scenario-origin or supported exposure-tertile mean exceeds comparator by10%. Reference cells need20 distinct seeds; transport scenario-origin cells need10. Each transport world aggregate cannot exceed comparator by5%, or scored scenario-origin means by20%. Survey retained coverage must exceed90%overall perworld and80%each baseline-eligible scenario-origin. Hiring aggregate opening-weighted absbias<=3pp and ECE<=5pp perworld, and pooled Brier/logloss no more than2%worse than each comparator. Count absmeanbias<=10%meanobservedcount perworld; survey absbias<=2scorepoints perworld. Zero-native-support cells remain explicitly out of scope; cells eligible but instrument-incomparable are unscored and remain out of accuracy scope. Any other undersupported criterion is insufficient evidence and rejects. No post-test subset may be promoted after broad rejection.
calibration: Diagnostics only; no candidate recalibration. Hiring fixed10 equal-width probability bins report openings, cohort rows and distinct seeds, bias, ECE and aggregate-binomial proper scores. Bins with fewer than5 seeds or500 openings marked sparse; no individual calibration claim. Count and survey bias are point-forecast diagnostics, not probability calibration. No prediction intervals.
uncertainty: Bootstrap whole independent seeds, keeping matched scenarios/origins/world dependencies intact in each within-world comparison. Reference40 clusters and transport20 reused clusters, not hundreds of independent scenarios. Error-difference intervals are conditional synthetic diagnostics, not operational forecast uncertainty or real-world significance claims.
custody: Commit protocol and implementation before any new seed generation. Commit calibration-only thresholds before any reference/transport test generation. Models use only original training seeds/labels through June2025. Preserve every prior artifact. No tuning on prior test labels, no new-test champion selection, and one final broad-scope adopt/reject verdict per domain.
